cohort: The study included 474 maternal-neonatal dyads from a racially diverse population, consisting of term neonates.
finding: Maternal anemia is associated with significant complications in term neonates and their mothers, with a racial disparity observed in its prevalence and associated outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean-section rates were found to be higher in anemic mothers.
birth_weight: lower birth weights were observed in offspring of anemic mothers
